description: Retrieves all fields (standard and custom) for a Salesforce object with complete metadata including field types, constraints, picklist values, and relationships.

object_name.description: API name of the Salesforce object to describe. Use standard object names (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity) or custom object API names ending in __c.
object_name.human_parameter_description: Enter the API name of the Salesforce object you want to inspect. Standard objects use names like 'Account' or 'Contact'. Custom objects end with '__c'.
object_name.title: Object Name

name: get_all_fields_for_object

FieldMetadata.description: Metadata for a single field on the Salesforce object.

autoNumber.description: Whether this is an auto-number field.
autoNumber.title: Auto Number

relationshipName.description: Name of the relationship for reference/lookup fields.
relationshipName.title: Relationship Name

custom.description: True if this is a custom field (ends with __c), false for standard fields.
custom.title: Custom

idLookup.description: Whether this field can be used to look up records.
idLookup.title: Id Lookup

updateable.description: Whether the field can be modified on existing records.
updateable.title: Updateable

nillable.description: Whether the field can contain null values.
nillable.title: Nillable

calculatedFormula.description: The formula expression if this is a formula field.
calculatedFormula.title: Calculated Formula

scale.description: Number of decimal places for numeric fields.
scale.title: Scale

createable.description: Whether the field can be set when creating a record.
createable.title: Createable

precision.description: Total number of digits for numeric fields.
precision.title: Precision

type.description: Data type of the field (e.g., 'string', 'boolean', 'int', 'double', 'date', 'datetime', 'picklist', 'multipicklist', 'reference', 'id', 'textarea', etc.).
type.title: Type

picklistValues.description: Available options for picklist and multipicklist fields.
picklistValues.title: Picklist Values

restrictedPicklist.description: Whether the picklist only allows values from the defined list.
restrictedPicklist.title: Restricted Picklist

nameField.description: Whether this is the Name field for the object.
nameField.title: Name Field

groupable.description: Whether the field can be used in SOQL GROUP BY clauses.
groupable.title: Groupable

htmlFormatted.description: Whether the field contains HTML content.
htmlFormatted.title: Html Formatted

unique.description: Whether the field requires unique values.
unique.title: Unique

compoundFieldName.description: Name of the compound field this field belongs to (e.g., address components).
compoundFieldName.title: Compound Field Name

sortable.description: Whether the field can be used in SOQL ORDER BY clauses.
sortable.title: Sortable

calculated.description: Whether this is a formula field.
calculated.title: Calculated

externalId.description: Whether the field is marked as an external ID.
externalId.title: External Id

deprecatedAndHidden.description: Whether the field is deprecated and hidden.
deprecatedAndHidden.title: Deprecated And Hidden

inlineHelpText.description: Help text displayed for this field.
inlineHelpText.title: Inline Help Text

relationshipOrder.description: Order of this relationship in master-detail hierarchies.
relationshipOrder.title: Relationship Order

filterable.description: Whether the field can be used in SOQL WHERE clauses.
filterable.title: Filterable

referenceTo.description: List of object types this field can reference (for lookup/master-detail fields).
referenceTo.title: Reference To

label.description: Display label for the field in the UI.
label.title: Label

FieldMetadata.title: FieldMetadata

GetAllFieldsForObjectResponse.description: Response containing complete metadata for a Salesforce object including all fields.

custom.description: Whether this is a custom object (true) or standard (false).
custom.title: Custom

custom_fields_count.description: Number of custom fields on this object.
custom_fields_count.title: Custom Fields Count

fields.description: List of all fields on this object, including standard and custom fields.
fields.title: Fields

keyPrefix.description: Three-character prefix for record IDs of this object.
keyPrefix.title: Key Prefix

queryable.description: Whether the object can be queried via SOQL.
queryable.title: Queryable

replicateable.description: Whether the object can be replicated.
replicateable.title: Replicateable

retrieveable.description: Whether individual records can be retrieved.
retrieveable.title: Retrieveable

searchable.description: Whether the object can be searched via SOSL.
searchable.title: Searchable

standard_fields_count.description: Number of standard fields on this object.
standard_fields_count.title: Standard Fields Count

total_fields.description: Total number of fields on this object.
total_fields.title: Total Fields

undeletable.description: Whether deleted records can be restored.
undeletable.title: Undeletable

GetAllFieldsForObjectResponse.title: GetAllFieldsForObjectResponse

active.description: Whether this picklist value is currently active.
active.title: Active

defaultValue.description: Whether this is the default value for the picklist.
defaultValue.title: Default Value

label.description: Display label for this picklist value.
label.title: Label

value.description: API value stored when this option is selected.
value.title: Value
